WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         sc.scancount,
         sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT status,
         SUM(scancount) AS total_scancount,
         AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_avg FROM status_stats
)
SELECT ss.status,
       ss.total_scancount,
       ss.avg_gb_per_min,
       ss.avg_gb_per_min - o.mean_avg AS gap_from_mean
FROM status_stats ss
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;
